name: rule-shadow
description: Ship a clinical rule change safely — shadow-run proposed vs baseline rules over the same synthetic cohort, diff flagged volumes, gate on a golden regression cohort, and alarm when monitoring silently vanishes. The LLM only drafts the impact report, number-grounded. Demo; not a medical device. FastAPI + Next.js.

paragraphs: Pick a baseline ruleset and a proposed change, and watch the shadow engine compute exactly what the change would do to a synthetic cohort — before it ever touches a patient. (First run 10–20s.)
